content: {"judgements":[{"sentence_id":"d1","label":"UNDERSTATED","strongest_supported":"NacreFuse significantly outperforms VellumRerank on Kersey-QA in exact match (74.8% vs 73.9%; mean paired difference 0.9 points, Holm-adjusted p = 0.0336 at alpha = 0.05).","same_proposition":true,"justification":"T1.r1.ker and T1.r2.ker give 74.8 vs 73.9, and S1 shows a Holm-adjusted significant difference (p = 0.0336), so \"appears to\" hedges an established result.","confidence":"medium"},{"sentence_id":"d2","label":"SUPPORTED","strongest_supported":"NacreFuse outperforms VellumRerank on Kersey-QA in exact match (74.8% vs 73.9%), a statistically significant difference after Holm correction (adjusted p = 0.0336).","same_proposition":true,"justification":"T1 gives 74.8 vs 73.9; S1 reports Holm-adjusted p = 0.0336 < 0.05, so \"outperforms\" is entailed and the stated numbers match.","confidence":"high"},{"sentence_id":"d3","label":"UNDERSTATED","strongest_supported":"NacreFuse outperforms VellumRerank on Kersey-QA, averaging 74.8% vs 73.9% exact match, a difference significant after Holm correction (adjusted p = 0.0336).","same_proposition":true,"justification":"\"Tentatively\" undersells a difference that S1 establishes as significant after Holm adjustment (p = 0.0336); T1 means 74.8 vs 73.9 are correct.","confidence":"medium"}]}
